summary: Lenovo IdeaPad Gaming 3i System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling, BSOD due to excessive CPU temperature
suggested_solution: Set custom power limits instead of relying on boost mode.
Ensure the system is set to Performance mode using both Lenovo's power mode (FN+Q) and Windows' power mode (Windows battery icon).
Adjust the Maximum processor frequency in Power Plan settings to achieve the desired clock speed.
